title: モバイルアプリケーション
subtitle: Mobile Application
educationalGoal: In this course, students will learn how to develop graphical interactive Web applications for mobile devices such as smartphones and tablets using HTML/CSS/JavaScript.
advice: In this course, students will develop applications on the client side of the Web using JavaScript. As basic knowledge, it is assumed that students have acquired the HTML/CSS webpage creation method that was taught in the first-year “Web Design” class. In this class, students will learn basic application development methods using JavaScript through exercises and assignments. As an overall assignment, teams will be formed to address themes related to community contributions. Therefore, students are expected and encouraged to collect information about the region and try to extract relevant issues on a continuing basis.
requiredKnowledge: Students are expected to have basic knowledge of object-oriented languages and HTML/CSS. In addition, students will need to install the Google Chrome browser on their laptop in order to use the features of Google Chrome developer tools.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand and explain basic JavaScript code.
Be able to utilize basic technologies such as event processing and Canvas drawing.
Be able to design and develop graphical applications that are intended for mobile use.
Be able to design and develop applications using functions specific to mobile devices such as GPS and sensors
